dataset.name: ListenFlow sentence comprehension
dataset.notes: Original single-sentence items written for ListenFlow. Each sentence hinges on one grammatical feature (focus); the question asks for the meaning that depends on it, so hearing every word is not enough without processing the structure.

items.text: I didn't buy the blue jacket, I bought the black one.
items.q: 話し手が買ったのは？
items.explain: didn't buy the blue … bought the black one

items.text: The shop opens at nine, but the cafe inside doesn't open until ten.
items.q: 店の中のカフェが開くのは？
items.explain: doesn't open until ten = 10時まで開かない

items.text: My sister is two years older than me, and my brother is the youngest.
items.q: 3人の中で一番年下は？
items.explain: my brother is the youngest

items.text: I used to walk to school, but now I take the bus.
items.q: 話し手の今の通学方法は？
items.explain: used to walk = 以前は歩いていた / now I take the bus

items.text: We need four tickets for adults and two for children.
items.q: 必要なチケットは全部で何枚？
items.explain: four + two = six

items.text: Tom called his sister because she needed help with her car.
items.q: 車のことで助けが必要だったのは？
items.explain: his sister … because she needed help with her car

items.text: You don't have to bring anything, but you can bring a dessert if you like.
items.q: 持ち物について正しいのは？
choices: デザートを必ず持っていく
何も持っていってはいけない
何も持っていかなくてよいが、デザートを持ってきてもよい
items.explain: don't have to = しなくてよい / can = してもよい

items.text: The hotel was expensive, but the room was really small.
items.q: ホテルについての話し手の印象は？
items.explain: expensive, but … small

items.text: None of the trains to the airport are running this morning.
items.q: 今朝の空港行きの電車は？
items.explain: None of … are running

items.text: The package was delivered to my neighbor while I was at work.
items.q: 荷物を受け取ったのは？
items.explain: was delivered to my neighbor

items.text: If it rains tomorrow, the picnic will be moved to Sunday.
items.q: 明日雨が降ったらどうなる？
choices: ピクニックは日曜日に延期
items.explain: will be moved to Sunday

items.text: I'll call you after I finish the report, probably around four.
items.q: 電話をかけるのはいつ？
choices: 報告書を書き終えた後、4時ごろ
4時ちょうどに報告書を書き始める
items.explain: after I finish the report, around four

items.text: The new phone isn't as heavy as the old one, but the battery doesn't last as long.
items.q: 新しい電話について正しいのは？
choices: 古い電話より重く、電池が長持ち
古い電話より軽く、電池が長持ち
古い電話より軽いが、電池は長持ちしない
items.explain: isn't as heavy = より軽い / doesn't last as long = 長持ちしない

items.text: By the time we got to the cinema, the movie had already started.
items.q: 映画館に着いたとき、映画は？
choices: まだ始まっていなかった
ちょうど始まるところだった
items.explain: had already started

items.text: You should have told me earlier, I could have helped you.
items.q: 話し手が言いたいことは？
choices: 早めに言ってくれて助かった
もっと早く言ってくれれば手伝えたのに
items.explain: should have told … could have helped = 実際は言われず、手伝えなかった

items.text: I have two meetings today: the first is with the bank, and the second is with a client.
items.q: 2つ目の会議の相手は？
items.explain: the second is with a client

items.text: It's not that I don't like the plan, I just think it's too early to decide.
items.q: 話し手の考えは？
choices: 計画は気に入っているが、決めるのは早い
items.explain: It's not that I don't like … = 嫌いなわけではない

items.text: The decision to close the factory was made before the new manager was hired.
items.q: 先に起きたのは？
choices: 新しいマネージャーの採用
items.explain: was made before the new manager was hired

items.text: Unless we get the client's approval by Friday, we can't start the project next week.
items.q: 来週プロジェクトを始めるには？
choices: 金曜までに顧客の承認が必要
金曜に顧客と会う必要がある
承認なしでも始められる
来週承認をもらえばよい
items.explain: Unless … = もし…しなければ

items.text: Sales were slightly higher than last year, though far lower than we had expected.
items.q: 売上について正しいのは？
choices: 前年より少し低く、予想どおり
前年より少し高いが、予想よりはるかに低い
前年と同じで予想より高い
items.explain: slightly higher than last year / far lower than we had expected

items.text: I've been working on this presentation since Monday, and I'm still not finished.
items.q: プレゼン資料の状況は？
choices: 月曜から作っていて、まだ終わっていない
月曜に作り始める予定
items.explain: have been working … since Monday / still not finished

items.text: Of the two proposals, the latter is cheaper, but the former is faster to build.
items.q: 早く作れるのはどちら？
items.explain: the former = 前者（1つ目）

items.text: The printer must be out of paper, because it was working fine an hour ago.
items.q: 話し手の推測は？
choices: 紙がなくなったに違いない
紙を補充しなければならない規則がある
items.explain: must be = …に違いない（推量）

items.text: Although the train was delayed, we still arrived before the ceremony began.
items.q: 式典に間に合った？
items.explain: Although … still arrived before the ceremony began

items.text: Hardly anyone in the office knew about the merger until it was announced.
items.q: 合併について、発表前に知っていたのは？
choices: ほとんど誰も知らなかった
items.explain: Hardly anyone = ほとんど誰も…ない

items.text: Had we launched a month earlier, we would have beaten our competitors to the market.
items.q: 実際に起きたことは？
choices: 1か月早く発売し、競合に勝った
発売が遅く、競合に先を越された
競合より先に発売した
items.explain: Had we launched … = もし…していたら（実際はしていない）

items.text: The software is being tested by an outside company, not by our own team.
items.q: ソフトのテストをしているのは？
items.explain: is being tested by an outside company, not by our own team

items.text: The more data the model sees, the less often it makes the same mistake.
items.q: モデルについて正しいのは？
choices: データが多いほど同じ誤りが減る
データが多いほど誤りが増える
データ量と誤りは関係ない
データが少ないほど正確
items.explain: The more …, the less …

items.text: By next spring, the company will have opened offices in three more countries.
items.q: 来春までに何が起きる？
choices: さらに3か国に事務所を開いている
3か国目の事務所を検討し始める
すでに3か国に事務所がある
items.explain: will have opened … in three more countries

items.text: The CEO thanked the engineers, whose work had made the launch possible.
items.q: 発売を可能にしたのは？
items.explain: the engineers, whose work had made the launch possible

items.text: You didn't need to print the slides, we're sharing them on screen.
items.q: 話し手が言いたいことは？
choices: スライドを印刷してほしい
印刷する必要はなかった
スライドを作り直すべき
items.explain: didn't need to print = 印刷する必要はなかった

items.text: Far from reducing costs, the new system has actually made our process more expensive.
items.q: 新しいシステムの結果は？
choices: かえってコストが上がった
items.explain: Far from reducing costs = コストを下げるどころか

items.text: Not until the audit was complete did anyone realize how much money had gone missing.
items.q: 紛失額に気づいたのはいつ？
items.explain: Not until … did anyone realize = …して初めて気づいた

items.text: Were the regulations to change, smaller firms would be hit far harder than large ones.
items.q: 規制が変わった場合の影響は？
choices: 大企業のほうが打撃が大きい
中小企業のほうがはるかに打撃が大きい
中小企業が有利になる
items.explain: smaller firms would be hit far harder

items.text: The findings, which had been dismissed by most experts at the time, were later confirmed by several independent studies.
items.q: その研究結果は最終的に？
choices: 専門家に支持され続けた
複数の独立した研究で確かめられた
items.explain: were later confirmed by several independent studies

items.text: The second quarter was no better than the first, despite all the changes we made.
items.q: 第2四半期の結果は？
choices: 第1四半期より良かった
第1四半期と変わらず良くなかった
第1四半期より大幅に悪化
items.explain: no better than = …と同じくらい良くない

items.text: Had it not been for the backup servers, we would be dealing with a complete outage right now.
items.q: 現在の状況は？
choices: システムが完全に停止している
予備サーバーのおかげで完全停止は避けられている
予備サーバーが故障した
items.explain: Had it not been for … = …がなかったら（実際はあった）

items.text: Both candidates were impressive, but only the one with management experience was offered the position.
items.q: 採用されたのは？
choices: 管理職経験のある候補者
items.explain: only the one with management experience was offered the position

items.text: The update can't have caused the crash, since it hadn't even been installed yet.
items.q: 話し手の結論は？
choices: 更新が原因に違いない
更新が原因のはずがない
更新をすぐ入れるべき
原因は更新かもしれない
items.explain: can't have caused = …したはずがない

items.text: While the model performs well on benchmarks, it struggles with questions it hasn't seen before.
items.q: そのモデルの弱点は？
choices: ベンチマークの成績が低い
初めて見る質問に弱い
items.explain: struggles with questions it hasn't seen before
